title: Take your lists away as a spreadsheet

steps.say: **Export CSV** takes whoever is currently on screen away as a file — for a report, a governors' meeting, or your own sums.
The export follows your filters, not the whole school. Filter or search the list down first, or clear the filters if you want everybody.
The file downloads with today's date in its name and opens in whatever spreadsheet you use. The **Teachers** page carries the same button along the top.
steps.terminal: That's your list out as a file — what you filtered is what you get. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
